name: slash-discrimination
description: 連続スラッシュの畳み（仮説 b）を切り分けるフィクスチャ。3 回目の swcutil（macOS 26.6.2）で `/a//b`・`/a//b/` vs `/a/b`、`//buy` vs `/buy`、`/p//1234` vs `/p/????` が MATCHED となり、仮説 b が確認された。全件検証済み。

cases.note: observed via swcutil (macOS 26.6.2, 3rd run): pattern /buy matches /buy///
observed via swcutil (macOS 26.6.2, 3rd run): pattern /a/b matches /a//b (consecutive slashes collapsed)
observed via swcutil (macOS 26.6.2, 3rd run): pattern /a/b matches /a//b/ (collapse then strip trailing slash)
observed via swcutil (macOS 26.6.2, 3rd run): pattern /buy matches //buy (leading // collapsed)
observed via swcutil (macOS 26.6.2, 3rd run): pattern /a/*/b matches /a//b/
observed via swcutil (macOS 26.6.2, 3rd run): pattern /p/???? matches /p//1234 (collapsed to /p/1234)
observed via swcutil (macOS 26.6.2, 3rd run): pattern /buy// matches URL /buy (pattern slashes collapsed/stripped)
